script_text: Pisces, Neptune, your water ruler, rewires this week's work-and-love chart. Monday through Wednesday, New Moon in Virgo, your 6th House, arrives as Mercury is retrograde; Mercury quincunxes Pluto in 11th House, so verify contracts, messages, and career data. Tuesday is your worst day because Mars squares the Sun and Venus quincunxes Saturn, exposing work errors and romantic tension. Wednesday turns the tide as the New Moon clarifies priorities and Jupiter squares Neptune in your 1st House, exposing romantic projections. Thursday through Sunday, Venus in 7th House sharpens romantic honesty, while Venus trines Pluto in 11th House, bringing real freelance payments this coming weekend. Friday is your power day because Venus supports a love conversation and the transit favors a practical proposal. Saturday stays noisy because Mercury is retrograde in 6th House, but Sunday's direct station offers release. Follow evidence, not mood. Follow for daily updates.
